name: Shri Mukul Wasnik
education: M.A., M.B.A. Educated at St. Francis De'Sales High School, Nagpur, Hislop College and Department of Business Management, Nagpur University, Nagpur, Maharashtra
social_activities: Agriculture, law, labour, education and upliftment of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes; environment protection and wildlife
hobbies: Wildlife photography, reading and travelling, cricket and athletics; Member, (i) India International Centre, (ii) India Habitat Centre, (iii) DDA Sports Club, Siri Fort, New Delhi and (iv) India Islamic Cultural Centre
countries_visited: Japan, Philippines, Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, Egypt, Turkey, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Maldives, Russia, U.K., Switzerland, France, Canada, U.S.A., Nicaragua, Bangladesh, D.P.R. Korea and China; attended 12th World Festival of Youth and Students, U.S.S.R., 1985; Member, delegation to the United Nations 42nd General Assembly Session, 1987; and 10th Anniversary Celebrations of Sandinista Front, Nicaragua, 1987; Leader, (i) Indian delegation to the 13th World Festival of Youth and Students in D.P.R. Korea and (ii) Youth Delegation to the Closing Ceremony of the Festival of India in U.S.S.R., 1987; attended (i) the inaugural function of the Festival of India in U.S.S.R., 1987 and (ii) Conservative Party Annual Conference U.K., 1988; accompanied Hon'ble Vice-President during his visit to Turkey in 2011; attended 13th Congress of the United Russia Party held in 2012 in Russia; Israel; Nepal to attend the National Convention of Nepali Congress in 2021
other_information: Vice-President, Hislop College Student`s Council, 1980-1981; Secretary, Nagpur University Student`s Council, 1981-82; National Treasurer, National Students` Union of India (N.S.U.I.), 1984-85; National President, N.S.U.I., 1985-88; President, Indian Youth Congress, 1988-90; Secretary, A.I.C.C., 1998-2000; Member, Congress Working Committee (C.W.C.) since 2001; General Secretary, A.I.C.C. since 2002; Member, Central Election Committee, Indian National Congress since 2011
